description_en: Performs a paged query to retrieve the paging list of subscribe records for a specified API product. The records can be filtered by subscribe status and searched by consumer name keywords. Each record includes the subscribe ID, API product ID and name, API product type, consumer ID and name, and subscribe status
description_zh: 分页查询指定 API 产品的订阅记录列表，可按订阅状态筛选，也支持按消费者名称关键词搜索；每条记录返回订阅 ID、API 产品 ID 与名称、API 产品类型、消费者 ID 与名称以及订阅状态
kebab_example: aliyun apig list-product-subscriptions --product-id product-xxxxxxxx --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --status APPROVED --consumer-name consumer-1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListProductSubscriptions

parameters.help_en: The ID of the API product. This is the primary ID of the API product resource and specifies the API product for which you want to query the subscription list. You can obtain this ID from the productId field in the response of the ListProducts operation
parameters.help_zh: API 产品 ID，即 API 产品资源 Product 的一级 ID，指定要查询哪个 API 产品的订阅列表。可由查询API产品列表（ListProducts）返回的列表项 productId 获得
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The subscription status used to filter subscriptions. Valid values: PENDING and APPROVED
parameters.help_zh: 订阅状态，用于按状态筛选订阅。取值：PENDING、APPROVED
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The keyword of the consumer name used to search the subscription records of the API product by consumer name
parameters.help_zh: 消费者名称关键词，用于按 Consumer 名称搜索该 API 产品的订阅记录
parameters.name: consumer_name

content.description_en: The subscription list of the API product. The list element is named subscription, and each element represents an API product subscription record
content.description_zh: 该 API 产品的订阅列表，列表元素名为 subscription，每个元素为一条 API 产品订阅记录

consumerId.description_en: The ID of the consumer to which the subscription belongs. This ID and the consumerName returned in the same element refer to the same consumer
consumerId.description_zh: 订阅所属消费者的 ID，与同元素返回的 consumerName 指向同一个消费者

consumerName.description_en: The name of the consumer to which the subscription belongs. This corresponds to the keyword search for the consumerName request parameter
consumerName.description_zh: 订阅所属消费者的名称，与入参 consumerName 的关键词搜索对应

productId.description_en: The ID of the subscribed API product. This is the primary ID of the API product resource and is the same as the productId path parameter in this operation
productId.description_zh: 被订阅的 API 产品 ID，即 API 产品资源 Product 的一级 ID，与本接口的路径入参 productId 为同一标识

productName.description_en: The name of the subscribed API product. This is the Name property of the API product resource
productName.description_zh: 被订阅的 API 产品名称，即 API 产品资源 Product 的 Name 属性

productType.description_en: The type of the subscribed API product. Valid values: REST_API, HTTP_API, MCP_SERVER, AGENT_API, and MODEL_API
productType.description_zh: 被订阅的 API 产品类型。取值：REST_API、HTTP_API、MCP_SERVER、AGENT_API、MODEL_API

status.description_en: The subscription status. Valid values: PENDING and APPROVED. (These values are defined in the enumeration for the status request parameter. This response parameter is not annotated with @enums.)
status.description_zh: 订阅状态。取值：PENDING、APPROVED（该取值集合声明在本篇入参 status 的枚举上，本出参未挂 @enums）

subscriptionId.description_en: The subscription ID, which identifies an API product subscription record. You can use this ID to cancel the subscription by calling UnsubscribeHiMarketProduct or approve the subscription by calling ApproveProductSubscription. Both operations locate the record by using the /himarket/v1/consumers/{consumerId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId} path
subscriptionId.description_zh: 订阅 ID，标识一条 API 产品订阅记录。可用于 UnsubscribeHiMarketProduct 取消该订阅、ApproveProductSubscription 审批该订阅，二者均以 /himarket/v1/consumers/{consumerId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId} 定位该记录

pageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

v1_parameters.help_en: The keyword of the consumer name used to search the subscription records of the API product by consumer name
v1_parameters.help_zh: 消费者名称关键词，用于按 Consumer 名称搜索该 API 产品的订阅记录
v1_parameters.name: consumerName

v1_parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1
v1_parameters.name: pageNumber

v1_parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
v1_parameters.name: pageSize

v1_parameters.help_en: The ID of the API product. This is the primary ID of the API product resource and specifies the API product for which you want to query the subscription list. You can obtain this ID from the productId field in the response of the ListProducts operation
v1_parameters.help_zh: API 产品 ID，即 API 产品资源 Product 的一级 ID，指定要查询哪个 API 产品的订阅列表。可由查询API产品列表（ListProducts）返回的列表项 productId 获得
v1_parameters.name: productId

v1_parameters.help_en: The subscription status used to filter subscriptions. Valid values: PENDING and APPROVED
v1_parameters.help_zh: 订阅状态，用于按状态筛选订阅。取值：PENDING、APPROVED
